summary: Complaints centre on poor roads, irregular farm power, a missing Kali river bridge and fertiliser shortages, while the appreciation found is mostly for roads and a bridge still at tender or construction stage.

positives.english: Tenders for new roads are done, now we wait for construction to start
positives.hindi: सड़कों के टेंडर हो गए, अब बस काम शुरू होने का इंतजार है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (11 Oct 2026): twelve roads worth about Rs 21 crore tendered under the CM rural road scheme, six of them in Atrauli constituency (about Rs 10 crore, e.g. Tarachi to Sirsa, Pendhara to Rajgaon Gazipur). PWD says construction will start soon. Tender stage only; no completion reported.

positives.english: Work on the Kali river bridge has started, hope it gets finished soon
positives.hindi: काली नदी पर पुल का काम शुरू हुआ है, उम्मीद है जल्दी बनेगा
positives.basis: The Wire (7 Feb 2022): bridge over the Kaali river between Atrauli and Jawan was under construction with about a dozen labourers; the only road alternative is about five times longer. Villagers hoped it would be built. Status after 2022 not confirmed. Sourced, but dated.

positives.english: Kutcha village roads in the Atrauli block are being sanctioned for pakka construction
positives.hindi: गांवों की कच्ची सड़कें पक्की बनाने का काम मंजूर हुआ है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (1 Nov 2024): about Rs 2.5 crore spent by the kshetra panchayat on roads in several villages of Atrauli block that had been unpaved since independence; tenders issued, construction to finish in three months. Block-level report, village list not given; AC membership not separately confirmed. Dated 2024, completion not confirmed.

positives.english: Amrit Sarovar built in Naoari had villagers walking there morning and evening
positives.hindi: अमृत सरोवर बना तो सुबह-शाम यहीं घूमने आते थे
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (19 Mar 2026): Amrit Sarovar in Naoari gram panchayat (Atrauli block), built in 2023 with benches, trees, walking path and gate. Villagers initially used it morning and evening, sitting by the clear water. Past benefit only; the pond has since dried (see negatives). Naoari's AC membership not confirmed.

positives.english: Municipal board has started a cleanliness and greening drive in town
positives.hindi: नगर पालिका ने सफाई और हरियाली का अभियान शुरू किया है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026): Atrauli municipal board put up Green Atrauli-Clean Atrauli cutouts and lighting at Avantibai crossing and an I Love Atrauli selfie point at the roadways bus stand; chairman says a plantation drive will run in every ward (no dates). The article reports no measurable results and no residents' praise by name.

negatives.english: Power comes for only 4-5 hours instead of 10, and it keeps tripping, so the maize is drying
negatives.hindi: बिजली 10 घंटे की जगह बस 4-5 घंटे मिलती है, मक्का सूख रहा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (28 May 2026): for about 15 days farmers of the Paneha feeder (Atrauli area; villages named include Rajatau and Nahal) got 4-5 hours instead of 10 and repeated trips; no daytime irrigation; maize at risk; farmers demand 12 hours. JE blames overloading and says it will be resolved soon. Nahal Panehra is listed among Atrauli constituency roads in the 11 Oct 2026 Amar Ujala tender report.

negatives.english: Atrauli-Ganiyavli-Gazipur road is full of potholes and waterlogs in rain
negatives.hindi: अतरौली-गनियावली-गाजीपुर सड़क पर गड्ढे हैं, बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (26 May 2026): Atrauli-Ganiyavli-Gazipur road in poor condition; Yuva Pahal president says large potholes and waterlogging disrupt movement in rains, hitting school children, patients and farmers. BDO says a complaint letter will go to PWD. A dharna on the same demand was held 1 Jan 2023 with no action since. Road starts in Atrauli town, so AC membership follows the namesake-town rule.

negatives.english: No bridge over the Kali river, we still cross by boat
negatives.hindi: काली नदी पर आज भी पुल नहीं है, नाव से पार करना पड़ता है
negatives.basis: The Wire (7 Feb 2022): villages on both banks of the Kaali river between Atrauli and Jawan (Sila, Alampur, Chaunchai, Dharampur, Sikandarpur among about a dozen) cross by boat almost daily; one boat at Alampur, villagers queue; a crossing via the longer road is about five times longer. Dated 2022; current status not confirmed.

negatives.english: We queue for urea from morning, still get only two bags
negatives.hindi: यूरिया के लिए सुबह से लाइन में लगते हैं, फिर भी दो बोरी मिलती है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (5 Aug 2025): at the Atrauli PCF centre and cooperative society, farmers from Gaziapur, Harchandpur and Khera queued from early morning in rain, needed 5-10 bags, received two bags each; scuffle with police; private shops also lacked urea. Secretary says distribution matched the stock. Dated 2025.

negatives.english: The Amrit Sarovar has dried up and cow dung is kept there
negatives.hindi: अमृत सरोवर सूख गया है, वहां गोबर रखा जा रहा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (19 Mar 2026): Amrit Sarovar in Naoari gram panchayat, Atrauli block, built 2023, has dried; dung cakes stacked on the flag platform and dung spread across the dry pond; the report implies neglect but quotes no villager. AC membership of Naoari not confirmed by the Wikipedia extent list, so this is not counted in ac_specific_negatives.

notes: Identity: Wikipedia Atrauli Assembly constituency page gives No. 73, Atrauli, Aligarh district, reserved None, Lok Sabha Aligarh, electors 4,04,658 (2022); its extent lists Atrauli KCs, Dadon, Bijoli, Gaonkhera, Ganiyawali, Jujharka, Gobli, Chendauli Buzurg, Bhavigarh, Koreh Raghupura, Fazalpur, Rehmapur, Gajipur, Tebthu, Madapur, Utara, Puraini Ismailpur, Barala KC and Atrauli MB. The List of constituencies page leaves the district cell blank for row 73; district taken from the Atrauli page and the district grouping. Region is Braj, matching AC-071 (Khair, Aligarh) in this repo. The aligarh.nic.in SIR list was unreachable (HTTP 503) and is not cited. Weaknesses: (1) positives are thin and mostly tender or announcement stage (roads, municipal drive) plus a 2022 bridge under construction and a 2023 pond; no sourced voter appreciation for a delivered benefit was found. (2) Several sources are dated 2022-2025 (Wire 2022, block roads Nov 2024, urea Aug 2025); status today is unverified. (3) Naoari and Rajatau AC membership unconfirmed; Nahal Panehra and Chaunchai/Chauchai appear in the Atrauli constituency tender list, which supports the Paneha feeder and Kali river villages. (4) Searches for Atrauli-specific health, water (JJM), stray cattle, markets, schools and flooding returned nothing local, so those were not used. (5) The Khair Road drain story and the Ghaziabad/Gonda/Muzaffarnagar items were found but are not Atrauli and were not used. Field check recommended on the Kali bridge status and the Paneha feeder hours.
